provisions.label: Commission AI Omnibus news item (2026), §1
provisions.title: Innovation support
provisions.text: Support for growing companies : Some measures previously reserved for SMEs are extended to small mid-cap companies (SMCs), helping more businesses benefit from a proportionate approach Testing and experimentation : Expands access to regulatory sandboxes and introduces an EU-level regulatory sandbox, giving companies more space to develop and test AI systems under regulatory supervision

meta.document: Commission web pages on the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)

provisions.label: Commission AI Omnibus news item (2026), §2
provisions.title: Extended timelines
provisions.text: High-risk AI systems in Annex III : Rules apply starting 2 December 2027 High-risk AI embedded in physical products (machinery, toys, lifts, etc.) in Annex I : Rules apply starting 2 August 2028

meta.document: Commission web pages on the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)

provisions.label: Commission AI Omnibus news item (2026), §3
provisions.title: Reduced administrative burdens
provisions.text: Simplification for SMCs : Extends simplified legal obligations for SMEs to small and mid-cap companies AI literacy : Previous AI literacy requirement for companies is simplified, with the Commission and the Member States taking a stronger role in promoting AI literacy EU database registration : Simplifies obligation to register exempted AI systems in the EU central database

meta.document: Commission web pages on the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)

provisions.label: Commission AI Omnibus news item (2026), §4
provisions.title: Safety and fundamental rights
provisions.text: Ban on nudification apps : Prohibits AI systems that generate non-consensual sexually explicit and intimate content or child sexual abuse material Bias detection : Allows for the processing of special categories of personal data to detect and correct bias

meta.document: Commission web pages on the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)

provisions.label: Commission AI Omnibus news item (2026), §5
provisions.title: AI governance alignment
provisions.text: Extended enforcement powers : The AI Office will have extended oversight of certain AI systems, including those built on general-purpose models and embedded in large online platforms and search engines Legal and procedural clarity : Clarifies interplay between the AI Act and other EU laws and simplifies procedures for conformity assessment bodies
